tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Resolve any Indian Supreme Court reference — INSC neutral citation, SCC, AIR, MANU, party name + year, or free text — to the canonical INSC neutral citation with parallel citations, bench, decision date, official e-SCR link, and current treatment status.

tools.name: get_ratio
tools.description: Return the extractive, paragraph-anchored ratio decidendi and headnotes of a Supreme Court case. Never paraphrased; every holding carries a paragraph anchor.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search the insc.one Supreme Court index by natural-language issue, keyword, or legal proposition. Returns ranked cases with INSC citations, one-line holdings, and treatment signals.

tools.name: check_treatment
tools.description: Check whether a cited Supreme Court authority is still good law — overruled, distinguished, or affected by a larger bench under the Article 141 hierarchy. Run before including any authority.

tools.name: format_citation
tools.description: Return a ready-to-paste citation string that leads with the INSC neutral citation, with optional parallel reporters and a registry-style footnote.

tools.name: audit_brief
tools.description: Audit a brief, petition, or opponent argument for citation accuracy and Article 141 binding-precedent validity. Extracts every citation and verifies current treatment, flagging overruled authorities.

tools.name: check_cross_citations
tools.description: Check any set of citations against the complete insc.one Supreme Court cross-citation index (1950–2026). Returns per-row canonical Rosetta record or fail-closed NOT_FOUND.
